Conveniently located in Manhattan's upper west side, the excitement and activity of New York City is only moments away from this comfortable and cozy hotel, perfect for all of your traveling needs. 
The Days Inn Broadway at 94th Street is surrounded by some of the city's most famous attractions. Central Park, museums and gourmet restaurants are all located within walking distance from the hotel. 
The Days Broadway is a 2 minute walk to the nearest metro station.
After a long day in the city, guest can relax at the Days Inn Broadway and enjoy a number of modern amenities provided for their convenience, including a fitness center as well as free wireless internet.

The rooms are simply decorated and vary in size from medium to large rooms. Hotel features standard rooms with 1 full size bed. All rooms include Safety Deposit Box, TV, Telephone, Air Conditioning, Cable TV, Tea/Coffee Maker, Hairdryer, Iron, Work Desk, Ironing Facilities and Complimentary Wifi in all guest rooms. The bathrooms are small and in a good condition.

Please see essential info.
The building is traditional, built in 1915.
No on-site restaurant, but there is a restaurant next to the hotel serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. Numerous dining options and lounges are within walking distance.
The lobby is fairly large with some seating and a spacious corner reception area. The decor is in a traditional style with marbled flooring.
